g.text: PART 3 / 5 · NUTRITION · OMEGA-3, FIBER & THE GUT
OMEGA-3 AND FIBER DON'T SHOW ON THE TRACKER — THEY SHOW IN YOUR BLOOD AND YOUR GUT.
amber, not cyan — seductive-but-incomplete. the green tick is the trap instinct, not a real win.
LIMIT OF WHAT THE TRACKER SEES
~300–1,000 species live here · the "7 strains" is a marketing starter set
yoghurt · kefir · kimchi · sauerkraut · miso · tempeh
POLYPHENOL drips (selective fertilizer): berries · cacao >70% · olive oil · green tea · coffee
mostly placebo · never reaches the bed
tracker says you won · the gut starved
THE FIX — ONE CARTRIDGE, EVERY UNSENSED CHANNEL
"the single most cost-effective meal in the series"
~50 g PROTEIN · ~25–30 g FIBER (a full day) · ~10 PLANTS
yoghurt (probiotic) + inulin · psyllium · oat β-glucan · green-banana resistant starch
ONE BOWL FILLS THE BLIND SPOT.
15–20 g fiber · 5–7 plants · one probiotic hit
needs 300 ml water · drink it ALONE
in the bowl it's wallpaper paste
IF YOU'RE SO SMART, WHY ARE YOU NOT — HEALTHY · NUTRITION 3.0
MACROS BUILD THE BODY. THIS DECIDES THE BLOOD.
